artDirection: Crash 4 / punk / 90s, replacing rejected realistic references before any Meshy spend

prompts.moonbone-skull: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single prop reference for Meshy image-to-3D for a Crash Bandicoot 4 inspired 3D platformer with a playful 1990s skate-punk aesthetic. ART DIRECTION IS CRITICAL: exaggerated chunky cartoon shapes, strong graphic silhouette, crooked asymmetry, broad sculpted bevels, painterly saturated color blocking, clean large facets, confident hand-painted gradients, punchy cel-like shadow shapes. This is polished vibrant animated videogame art, mischievous and rebellious, not realistic, gothic, gritty, medieval, horror, gritty stone scan, or photorealistic. Keep surface detail bold enough to read on a TV. No realistic pore texture, no dense cracks, no tiny decorative carvings. Nighttime palette: creamy yellow ivory, saturated indigo-purple shadows, cobalt stone, electric cyan and small hot-magenta punk-paint accents. Isolated one complete solid 3D prop, front three-quarter view only 15 degrees off frontal, neutral flat blue-grey studio background with generous margin. Soft studio illumination shows the painted colors, no dramatic scene lighting. No environment, ground plane, watermark, text, or extra objects. Subject: one huge CARTOON skull monument with an oversized squashed cranium, outrageously thick slanted brow, comically mismatched deep eye sockets, two small angular cyan crystal pupils, broad triangular nose, huge widely spaced chunky square teeth and a squat jaw with a crooked goofy smirk. Stylized ivory fossil bone with lavender/indigo shadow patches; one bold hot-magenta diagonal face-paint stripe over one brow and small cyan zigzag paint marks on a cheek, like a 1990s skate-punk sticker graphic painted onto a skull. Slightly lopsided proportions, thick organic bone cheek shapes, three big exaggerated sculpted chips only. Skull should look like a mischievous environment mascot from Crash 4, emphatically NOT an anatomical human skull or horror skull. No pedestal, no horns, no floating decoration, no background.

Subject: a single giant playful cartoon fossil-bone arch for a platform game, a wide inverted U made from two thick exaggerated curved ribs with knobbly bulbous bone ends at the feet, connected at top by a chunky crooked vertebra. Overall width equals height. Each rib is a smooth broad flattened swooping S curve with angular planar ridges, irregular tapered proportions, two or three large cartoon chips. Huge completely open archway with empty space through it, no base across bottom. Creamy ivory with stylized lavender and indigo painted shadow shapes. Punk custom paint: two bold magenta diagonal bands near the bottom of one rib and a cyan zigzag stripe near the top of the other, painted directly onto the bone. No detailed fracture texture, no gothic tracery, no skull, no ground.

Subject: a squat oversized cartoon crypt shrine façade, width 1.5 times height. A crooked chunky doorway/alcove built from broad chunky blue-cobalt and purple stone blocks, leaning outward at the sides with an exaggerated trapezoid silhouette and overhanging bent lintel. A broad deep dark-violet recessed niche with solid back wall, one integrated small shelf with a large angular cyan crystal relic. Oversized ivory fossil-bone pillars and a small goofy bone skull emblem embedded in the lintel; mischievous cartoon skull, black angular sockets.
